root_causes: A1 verification checked only source_normalizer, fact_assembler, and compat for duplicate domain classes instead of scanning all production mode_p_vnext modules. Sixteen same-name canonical classes therefore remained outside mode_p_vnext.domain while no_duplicate_domain_authority was reported as passed.

The ReleaseLedger does not give A1 ownership of any offending source. Two offending files are assigned to A6 and six offending files are not assigned to any A0-A10 work package, so A1 cannot repair its required invariant within its declared allowed paths.

FactAssembler validates that a statement is contained somewhere inside a source span, not that the complete span canonically equals the statement. A scene-wide span can therefore be accepted as provenance for one short fact, contrary to architecture v3.0 section 6 exact-boundary semantics.
